13.
Expanded leverage option. This course we see as complex, difficult
                                and uncertain, but offering best possibility of eventual achievement
                                of US objectives. In summary, under it we would (a) offer ourselves
                                as certain supply source for limited but negotiable quantities of
                                certain types of military (lethal) equipment (b) continue economic

                                increased attention to East Pakistan,

and (c) accompany (a) and (b) by subtle but

Pak
financial institutions in Dacca)
